name: Gioia Tauro (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the crowned municipal arms of Gioia Tauro (palm trees beneath a star on red) within branches and the inscription CITTÀ DI GIOIA TAURO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Gioia Tauro, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Gioia Tauro arms — palm trees beneath a star on red, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI GIOIA TAURO arched above the arms
